name: Instant e-PAN (free PAN through Aadhaar)
description: Individuals without a PAN can obtain a digitally signed e-PAN free of cost on the Income Tax e-Filing portal using Aadhaar e-KYC, the Aadhaar-linked mobile number and DigiLocker.
description_hi: जिन व्यक्तियों के पास पैन नहीं है, वे आधार ई-केवाईसी, आधार से जुड़े मोबाइल नंबर और डिजिलॉकर की मदद से आयकर ई-फ़ाइलिंग पोर्टल पर निःशुल्क डिजिटल हस्ताक्षरित ई-पैन प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।
authority: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance
verification_notes: Eligibility: individual without an existing PAN, not a minor on the date of request, and not a Representative Assessee (u/s 160 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 / u/s 303 of the Income Tax Act, 2025). These eligibility conditions are stated in the description, not modelled as documents. Its relevance to employment is general (PAN is a tax identifier); no official source here states that an employer requires it.

requirements.name: Proof of date of birth available in DigiLocker (any one)
requirements.name_hi: डिजिलॉकर में उपलब्ध जन्म तिथि का प्रमाण (कोई एक)
requirements.notes: Fetched from DigiLocker with the applicant's consent.
